post.title: [Hiring] Remote Python / AI / ML Engineer – $3,000 USD/Month
post.body:
Hi everyone!

We are hiring an experienced Python / AI Engineer for a long-term remote opportunity.

We are looking for someone with strong technical skills and hands-on experience building AI-powered applications and scalable backend systems.

Required Skills:

* Python, FastAPI, Django
* Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
* LLMs, OpenAI APIs, LangChain
* Microsoft Azure and AWS
* REST APIs, SQL, PostgreSQL
* Docker, Git, CI/CD

Responsibilities:

* Develop and maintain Python backend services
* Build and integrate AI/ML solutions
* Design and optimize APIs
* Collaborate with our remote engineering team

Compensation: $3,000 USD/month

Schedule: [Specify expected weekly hours]

Location: Remote

Contract: Long-term

How to Apply:

Please send a Reddit DM with your resume, LinkedIn profile link, relevant experience, GitHub or portfolio, and availability.

Thank you!

analysis.summary: Seeking an experienced remote Python and AI engineer to build and maintain scalable backend systems and AI-powered applications.
analysis.applyInstructions: Please send a Reddit DM with your resume, LinkedIn profile link, relevant experience, GitHub or portfolio, and availability.

expect: follows the Reddit DM instruction: the comment is empty or a one-line note, the pitch is in the DM
ties the profile's Python, Node and PostgreSQL work to the post and does not claim LangChain, Azure, FastAPI or LLM experience the evidence does not show
does not make up weekly hours or availability (the post left its hours as an unfilled placeholder)
